items.quote: The quality of the silk exceeded my expectations. The silk is pure and luxurious, the weaving is impeccable, and the colors are even more vibrant in person. I wore it to my cousin's wedding and received countless compliments. Worth every rupee!

body.text: Rasika was born from a simple belief: that every woman deserves to experience the timeless elegance of authentic handloom sarees, and every artisan deserves recognition for their craft.

Founded in 2019 by textile enthusiast Priya Sharma, Rasika emerged from countless journeys across India's weaving heartlands – from the silk looms of Kanchipuram to the brocade ateliers of Varanasi. What started as a personal quest to preserve vanishing weaving traditions has blossomed into a movement celebrating India's rich textile heritage.

Today, we partner with over 150 master weavers across eight states, bringing their exceptional craftsmanship to discerning women who value authenticity, quality, and cultural legacy. Each saree in our collection is hand-selected, representing months of artisan labor and centuries of inherited wisdom.
